scope: Nynorsk support and shared-renderer refactor introduced in 0.6.0; historical investigation remains documented in SOURCES.md.
implementation_credit: National Library of Norway, Språkmodeller, with OpenAI Codex assistance.
limitations: Hashes verify inspected bytes and artifact identity, not authorship, linguistic correctness, native-speaker review, acoustic performance or continued upstream availability. Mutable reference-only pages are not immutable snapshots.

nn-grammar.title: Nynorsksenteret: Nynorsk grammatikk, Ordklasser og setningar
nn-grammar.role: Printed page 36: number forms; grammatical reference only, no document or upstream algorithm redistributed.

nn-abbreviations.title: Språkrådet: Forkortelser
nn-abbreviations.role: Abbreviation meanings read through the web interface; mutable reference-only page, not vendored or hash-pinned.

nn-dictionary.title: Nynorskordboka (Språkrådet and University of Bergen)
nn-dictionary.role: Gender and inflection facts; reference-only pages, no dictionary database or definitions imported.

cldr-nn-49.title: Unicode CLDR 49: common/main/nn.xml
cldr-nn-49.role: Selected unit and currency metadata manually adapted: sekund, minutt, timar, kilowattimar, radianar, steradianar, kuwaitiske dinarar. Full XML and inheritance/formatting machinery not bundled.

cldr-license-49.title: Unicode CLDR 49 copyright and permission notice
cldr-license-49.role: Unicode-3.0 permission notice reproduced for the selected locale metadata; LDML specification text not copied.

existing-provenance.title: Existing Bokmål investigation and policies at v0.5.0
existing-provenance.role: Historical NbAiLab/peresolb investigation, first-party arithmetic/span engine, SI/currency/legal/broadcaster sources; not a claim that all historical upstreams are hash-pinned.

project-policy.title: Project-authored Nynorsk reading policy
project-policy.role: Variant selection, gender propagation, natural decimal speech, context aliases, proper-name preservation, spellings and scope; not an external normative source.
